title: The Attrition Puzzle
subtitle: Voluntary attrition has gone from 8% to 18% in 12 months. Where are people going and why?
learning_objectives: Use AI to find where attrition is actually concentrated, not where people assume it is
Distinguish between what exit surveys say and what workforce data shows
Identify pay compression as a structural driver hidden inside survey responses
Build a retention brief that names the specific problem and a costed fix
deliverable: One-page retention brief for the CHRO board presentation
